lines.say: A baby in a basket, a king, and a sea that splits in two. This is the story of Moses!
To keep him safe, his mother hid baby Moses in a basket on the river Nile.
A princess of Egypt found the basket, and raised him in the palace.
When he grew up, Moses became a shepherd in the desert.
One day he saw a bush on fire, but it didn't burn up. And God spoke to him from the bush.
Moses went to Pharaoh and said: let my people go!
Finally, the people left Egypt. Thousands of families, walking into the desert.
But Pharaoh changed his mind, and sent his chariots after them!
They were trapped at the sea. So Moses raised his staff.
And the sea split in two! Two giant walls of water.
The people walked through on dry ground, and the water closed behind them.
On the other side, they sang and danced. Free at last! Follow for more Bible stories!
